title: Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors

abstractEnglish: We prove the Generalised Abundance Conjecture: if $`(X,B)`$ is a projective klt ℚ-pair over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, $`K_X+B`$ is pseudo-effective, M is a nef ℚ-Cartier divisor on X, and $`K_X+B+M`$ is nef, then $`K_X+B+M`$ is numerically equivalent to a semiample ℚ-Cartier divisor on X.
